```{=html}
<figure class="stats-monster">
<svg viewBox="0 0 430 215" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Animation: streams of data rain into the head of a Frankenstein monster; its head fills up, its eye lights up, and it shuffles off like a zombie, arms stretched out">
  <style>
/* Self-contained accent colour, so the SVG does not depend on a cached site stylesheet */
.accent  { color: var(--bs-primary, #388e00); }
.walker  { animation: walk 9s linear infinite; }
.body    { animation: sway 9s linear infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: 50% 100%; }
.leg1    { animation: leg1 9s linear infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: 50% 0%; }
.leg2    { animation: leg2 9s linear infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: 50% 0%; }
.rain    { animation: rain 9s linear infinite; }
.rain.r2 { animation-name: rain2; }
.rain.r3 { animation-name: rain3; }
.stream  { animation: stream 9s linear infinite; stroke-dasharray: 2 5; }
.brain   { animation: brain 9s linear infinite; }
.eye     { animation: eye 9s steps(1) infinite; }
.zap     { animation: zap 9s steps(1) infinite; }
@keyframes walk {
  0.0% { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1 }
  40.0% { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1 }
  90.0% { transform: translateX(250px); opacity: 1 }
  95.0% { transform: translateX(262px); opacity: 0 }
  99.0% { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 0 }
  100.0% { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1 }
}
@keyframes sway {
  0.0% { transform: rotate(0deg) }
  40.0% { transform: rotate(0deg) }
  42.0% { transform: rotate(4deg) }
  46.0% { transform: rotate(-2deg) }
  50.0% { transform: rotate(4deg) }
  54.0% { transform: rotate(-2deg) }
  58.0% { transform: rotate(4deg) }
  62.0% { transform: rotate(-2deg) }
  66.0% { transform: rotate(4deg) }
  70.0% { transform: rotate(-2deg) }
  74.0% { transform: rotate(4deg) }
  78.0% { transform: rotate(-2deg) }
  82.0% { transform: rotate(4deg) }
  86.0% { transform: rotate(-2deg) }
  90.0% { transform: rotate(4deg) }
  92.0% { transform: rotate(0deg) }
  100.0% { transform: rotate(0deg) }
}
@keyframes leg1 {
  0.0% { transform: rotate(0deg) }
  40.0% { transform: rotate(0deg) }
  42.0% { transform: rotate(22deg) }
  46.0% { transform: rotate(-22deg) }
  50.0% { transform: rotate(22deg) }
  54.0% { transform: rotate(-22deg) }
  58.0% { transform: rotate(22deg) }
  62.0% { transform: rotate(-22deg) }
  66.0% { transform: rotate(22deg) }
  70.0% { transform: rotate(-22deg) }
  74.0% { transform: rotate(22deg) }
  78.0% { transform: rotate(-22deg) }
  82.0% { transform: rotate(22deg) }
  86.0% { transform: rotate(-22deg) }
  90.0% { transform: rotate(22deg) }
  92.0% { transform: rotate(0deg) }
  100.0% { transform: rotate(0deg) }
}
@keyframes leg2 {
  0.0% { transform: rotate(0deg) }
  40.0% { transform: rotate(0deg) }
  42.0% { transform: rotate(-22deg) }
  46.0% { transform: rotate(22deg) }
  50.0% { transform: rotate(-22deg) }
  54.0% { transform: rotate(22deg) }
  58.0% { transform: rotate(-22deg) }
  62.0% { transform: rotate(22deg) }
  66.0% { transform: rotate(-22deg) }
  70.0% { transform: rotate(22deg) }
  74.0% { transform: rotate(-22deg) }
  78.0% { transform: rotate(22deg) }
  82.0% { transform: rotate(-22deg) }
  86.0% { transform: rotate(22deg) }
  90.0% { transform: rotate(-22deg) }
  92.0% { transform: rotate(0deg) }
  100.0% { transform: rotate(0deg) }
}
@keyframes rain {
  0.0% { transform: translateY(-150px) }
  35.0% { transform: translateY(45px) }
  100.0% { transform: translateY(45px) }
}
@keyframes rain2 {
  0.0% { transform: translateY(-170px) }
  35.0% { transform: translateY(50px) }
  100.0% { transform: translateY(50px) }
}
@keyframes rain3 {
  0.0% { transform: translateY(-140px) }
  35.0% { transform: translateY(48px) }
  100.0% { transform: translateY(48px) }
}
@keyframes stream {
  0.0% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; opacity: 0.6 }
  35.0% { stroke-dashoffset: -40; opacity: 0.6 }
  40.0% { stroke-dashoffset: -46; opacity: 0 }
  97.0% { opacity: 0 }
  100.0% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; opacity: 0.6 }
}
@keyframes brain {
  0.0% { opacity: 0 }
  35.0% { opacity: 0.35 }
  92.0% { opacity: 0.35 }
  100.0% { opacity: 0 }
}
@keyframes eye {
  0.0% { fill: transparent }
  36.0% { fill: currentColor }
  95.0% { fill: transparent }
}
@keyframes zap {
  0.0% { opacity: 0 }
  36.0% { opacity: 1 }
  40.0% { opacity: 0 }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .stats-monster * { animation: none !important; }
  .rain { transform: translateY(-75px); }
}
</style>

    <text class="rain r2" x="68" y="0" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9.5"><tspan x="68" dy="13">x̄</tspan><tspan x="68" dy="13">β</tspan><tspan x="68" dy="13">σ</tspan><tspan x="68" dy="13">p</tspan><tspan x="68" dy="13">θ</tspan><tspan x="68" dy="13">n</tspan><tspan x="68" dy="13">ε</tspan><tspan x="68" dy="13">μ</tspan><tspan x="68" dy="13">λ</tspan><tspan x="68" dy="13">ρ</tspan><tspan x="68" dy="13">t</tspan></text>
    <text class="rain r3" x="92" y="0" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9.5"><tspan x="92" dy="13">NA</tspan><tspan x="92" dy="13">3.1</tspan><tspan x="92" dy="13">42</tspan><tspan x="92" dy="13">.05</tspan><tspan x="92" dy="13">Inf</tspan><tspan x="92" dy="13">-1</tspan><tspan x="92" dy="13">NaN</tspan><tspan x="92" dy="13">0.9</tspan><tspan x="92" dy="13">7</tspan><tspan x="92" dy="13">1e3</tspan></text>
  </g>
  <g class="walker">
    <!-- legs -->
    <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round">
      <path class="leg1" d="M60 156 V202 H70"/>
      <path class="leg2" d="M74 156 V202 H84"/>
    </g>
    <g class="body" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
      <!-- hair: a histogram -->
      <g class="accent" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">
        <rect x="44" y="41" width="6" height="5"/><rect x="51" y="37" width="6" height="9"/>
        <rect x="58" y="33" width="6" height="13"/><rect x="65" y="31" width="6" height="15"/>
        <rect x="72" y="34" width="6" height="12"/><rect x="79" y="38" width="6" height="8"/>
        <rect x="86" y="42" width="6" height="4"/>
      </g>
      <!-- head, filling up with data -->
      <rect class="brain accent" x="42" y="46" width="52" height="50" rx="5" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/>
      <rect x="42" y="46" width="52" height="50" rx="5"/>
      <!-- forehead suture -->
      <path d="M48 56 H88 M54 52 V60 M64 52 V60 M74 52 V60 M84 52 V60" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <!-- x-bar eye, lights up once the data is in -->

      <!-- mouth: jagged -->

        <rect x="32" y="73" width="4" height="10" rx="1.5" fill="currentColor"/>
```
